urls.title: File URLs
urls.description: Direct links to video or audio files (MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI, MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC and most others FFmpeg reads), one per line. Apify key-value store record URLs are read with your token. YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X and other platform links, and private or internal addresses, are refused. Leave every source empty to convert a generated 3-second test clip. Failed files are free.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Optional alternative to File URLs, in Apify's request-list format (e.g. a file with one URL per line). Combined with File URLs.

keyValueStoreRecords.title: Key-value store records
keyValueStoreRecords.description: Files uploaded to an Apify key-value store, as storeId/recordKey or username~store-name/recordKey, one per line. Use this to convert your own files without hosting them anywhere.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: MP4: H.264 video and AAC audio, plays everywhere. WebM: VP9 video and Opus audio, for the web. MP3, M4A (AAC) and WAV: the audio track only, billed as audio minutes.

maxHeight.title: Max resolution (p)
maxHeight.description: 480, 720 or 1080: the shorter side of the output in pixels (a portrait 1080x1920 video is 1080p), with the longer side at most 16:9 of it. Smaller videos are never enlarged. The price per minute depends on this: 480p $0.008, 720p $0.02, 1080p $0.04.

crf.title: Quality (CRF)
crf.description: Video quality when no target size is set: lower is better and bigger. 18 is near-transparent, 23 the default, 28 small files, 32+ visibly soft. The same scale is used for WebM (mapped to VP9). Ignored for audio outputs and with a target size.

targetMb.title: Target file size (MB)
targetMb.description: Optional: compress each file to about this size instead of a fixed quality (e.g. 25 for Discord, 16 for WhatsApp). The bitrate is set from the length; if the first pass misses by more than 5%, it is encoded once more. Very small targets for long files get a warning. For MP3 and M4A it sets the audio bitrate. Leave empty for the CRF quality.

startSeconds.title: Start at (seconds)
startSeconds.description: Optional: trim the start. The output begins this many seconds into the file.

durationSeconds.title: Duration (seconds)
durationSeconds.description: Optional: keep only this many seconds from the start point. Leave empty for the rest of the file. You pay for the output length only.

mute.title: Remove audio
mute.description: MP4 and WebM only: drop the audio track.

maxDurationMinutes.title: Max output length (minutes)
maxDurationMinutes.description: Files whose output would be longer are skipped with a free error item (trim them with Start at and Duration, or raise this, up to 180). Caps the cost per file.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max input file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger downloads are skipped with a free error item.

timeoutSecs.title: Download timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Max time to download one file.
